integrity: Analytic rank-one proof with independent exact rational checks, no independent audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Canonical unweighted Euclidean orthogonal cut/cycle projectors on edge-subdivided finite simple graphs only; coordinatewise quasiconvex but not monotone or jointly quasiconvex; not arbitrary projections. General pointwise subdivision formula is prior work; novelty is corner max and rank-one fractional-convex principle. Broad bibliographic overlap risk remains.
title: A corner-maximum principle for endpoint Hodge norms under arbitrary graph subdivisions
